run_payload_registration: run the script to register an IntelRealSense payload on a Boston Dynamics Spot robot
register_payload_with_guid: register a payload on Spot using a custom GUID via the --guid-to-register CLI flag
list_payloads_on_robot: list all registered payloads on the Spot robot after registering a new one
update_payload_version: update the payload version on Spot using the update_payload_version API call
authenticate_and_connect_to_spot: authenticate and connect to a Spot robot using admin credentials from environment variables
